claim.claim-text: 1. A sensor controller (41) that is connected to a sensor and

is configured for detection of a plurality of active pens from which a signal is transmitted to the sensor, wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured to transmit an uplink signal (US) to be detected by the plurality of active pens, wherein the sensor controller is configured such that, in case where the sensor controller (41) detects only a first active pen, the uplink signal includes a first corresponding data corresponding to a first identification data of the first active pen, and wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured such that, in case where the sensor controller (41) detects the first active pen and a second active pen, the uplink signal includes the first corresponding data and a second corresponding data corresponding to a second identification data of the second active pen.
2. The sensor controller (41) according to claim 1, wherein the uplink signal includes a first detected flag for the first active pen and a second detected flag for the second active pen.
3. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 1 and 2,

wherein sensor controller (41) is configured such that, when the sensor controller (41) detects n active pens, the sensor controller (41) transmits n corresponding data to the n active pens by transmitting a plurality of uplink signals, wherein n is equal to or greater than 3, wherein each of the n corresponding data corresponds to identification data of each of the n active pens.
4. The sensor controller (41) according to claim 3, wherein the plurality of uplink signal is configured by lining up sets, each of which includes two corresponding data.

5. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured to increase the number of the uplink signals as the detection number of the active pens increases.

6. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured to transmit a command signal including data indicative of contents of a down link signal to be transmitted from the active pen.

7. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured to receive a signal transmitted from any one of the first active pen to the n<th> active pen and to extract the identification data of the active pen by which the signal has been transmitted.
8. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 3 to 7, wherein the plurality of uplink signals is configured by deploying n corresponding data after n detected flags.

9. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 3 to 7, wherein the plurality of uplink signals is configured by lining up sets, each of which includes one corresponding data after one detected flag in order.

10. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 3 to 7, the plurality of uplink signals is configured by lining up sets, each of which includes m corresponding data after m detected flags, wherein m is one of 3 to n-1.
11. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 3 to 10, wherein each of the corresponding data is deployed before a detected flag.

12. The sensor controller (41) according to any one of claims 3 to 11, wherein the sensor controller (41) is configured such that, in case where the sensor controller detects only the first active pen, the uplink signal includes the first corresponding data and an initial value for the second active pen.
